## A-D

### Chain Rule
Differentiating composite functions: $\frac{d}{dx}[f(g(x))] = f'(g(x)) \cdot g'(x)$

**Classes**: [12](class/class-12.html), [18](class/class-18.html), [19](class/class-19.html), [20](class/class-20.html), [21](class/class-21.html), [22](class/class-22.html), [23](class/class-23.html)

### Conditional Probability
$P(A|B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}$

**Classes**: [35](class/class-35.html), [37](class/class-37.html)

### Critical Points
Finding where $f'(x) = 0$ or $f'(x)$ is undefined

**Classes**: [24](class/class-24.html), [26](class/class-26.html), [27](class/class-27.html), [31](class/class-31.html)

### Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF)
$F(x) = P(X \leq x)$

**Classes**: [40](class/class-40.html), [41](class/class-41.html), [42](class/class-42.html), [44](class/class-44.html)

### Derivatives (Basic Rules)
Power rule, sum rule, constant multiple

**Classes**: [11](class/class-11.html), [16](class/class-16.html), [17](class/class-17.html), [18](class/class-18.html), [19](class/class-19.html)

## E-L

### Expected Value
- Discrete: $E[X] = \sum x_i p(x_i)$
- Continuous: $E[X] = \int x \cdot f(x) \, dx$

**Classes**: [35](class/class-35.html), [38](class/class-38.html), [39](class/class-39.html), [40](class/class-40.html), [41](class/class-41.html)

### Exponential Functions
$f(x) = ae^{bx}$ and properties

**Classes**: [3](class/class-3.html), [9](class/class-9.html), [11](class/class-11.html), [13](class/class-13.html)

### Functions
Evaluation, composition, domain, range

**Classes**: [1](class/class-1.html), [2](class/class-2.html), [6](class/class-6.html), [7](class/class-7.html), [12](class/class-12.html)

### Integration
Definite and indefinite integrals, Riemann sums

**Classes**: [36](class/class-36.html), [37](class/class-37.html), [38](class/class-38.html), [43](class/class-43.html), [44](class/class-44.html)

### Intermediate Value Theorem (IVT)
Existence of zeros for continuous functions

**Classes**: [11](class/class-11.html)

### Least Squares Regression
Minimizing squared residuals

**Classes**: [31](class/class-31.html), [32](class/class-32.html)

### Linearization
$L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x-a)$

**Classes**: [16](class/class-16.html)

### Logarithms
Properties and solving logarithmic equations

**Classes**: [9](class/class-9.html), [10](class/class-10.html), [12](class/class-12.html), [26](class/class-26.html)

## M-P

### Maximum Likelihood
Finding parameters that maximize likelihood/loglikelihood

**Classes**: [14](class/class-14.html), [15](class/class-15.html), [24](class/class-24.html), [25](class/class-25.html), [26](class/class-26.html), [27](class/class-27.html), [28](class/class-28.html), [29](class/class-29.html), [30](class/class-30.html)

### Optimization
Finding maximum/minimum values using derivatives

**Classes**: [24](class/class-24.html), [26](class/class-26.html), [27](class/class-27.html), [31](class/class-31.html)

### Partial Derivatives
$\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}$ for multivariable functions

**Classes**: [23](class/class-23.html), [28](class/class-28.html), [31](class/class-31.html)

### Percentiles
Finding $x_p$ such that $P(X \leq x_p) = p/100$

**Classes**: [40](class/class-40.html), [41](class/class-41.html), [42](class/class-42.html)

### Plotting (in R)
Using `plot()`, `lines()`, `abline()`

**Classes**: [3](class/class-3.html), [4](class/class-4.html), [11](class/class-11.html), [26](class/class-26.html)

### Probability
Basic rules, sample spaces, events

**Classes**: [7](class/class-7.html), [8](class/class-8.html), [13](class/class-13.html), [14](class/class-14.html), [34](class/class-34.html), [37](class/class-37.html), [39](class/class-39.html)

### Probability Density Function (PDF)
$f(x)$ such that $\int f(x) \, dx = 1$

**Classes**: [38](class/class-38.html), [39](class/class-39.html), [40](class/class-40.html), [41](class/class-41.html), [42](class/class-42.html)

### Product Rule
$\frac{d}{dx}[f(x) \cdot g(x)] = f'(x) \cdot g(x) + f(x) \cdot g'(x)$

**Classes**: [17](class/class-17.html), [18](class/class-18.html)

## Q-Z

### Quotient Rule
$\frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}\right] = \frac{f'(x) \cdot g(x) - f(x) \cdot g'(x)}{[g(x)]^2}$

**Classes**: [17](class/class-17.html), [18](class/class-18.html)

### Random Variables
Discrete and continuous random variables

**Classes**: [34](class/class-34.html), [38](class/class-38.html), [39](class/class-39.html), [42](class/class-42.html)

### Second Derivative Test
Classifying critical points as maxima or minima using $f''(x)$

**Classes**: [23](class/class-23.html), [26](class/class-26.html), [27](class/class-27.html)

### Solving Equations (uniroot)
Using `uniroot()` in R to solve equations numerically

**Classes**: [10](class/class-10.html), [11](class/class-11.html), [12](class/class-12.html), [17](class/class-17.html)

### Variance
- Discrete: $\text{Var}(X) = E[X^2] - (E[X])^2$
- Continuous: Same formula with integrals

**Classes**: [39](class/class-39.html), [40](class/class-40.html), [41](class/class-41.html), [42](class/class-42.html)

### Visual Model Fitting
Selecting parameters to match data visually

**Classes**: [6](class/class-6.html), [11](class/class-11.html), [12](class/class-12.html)

## By Week

### Weeks 1-2: Functions and Modeling
**Classes**: 1-8
**Topics**: Function evaluation, plotting, visual fitting, probability basics

### Weeks 3-4: Solving Equations
**Classes**: 9-15
**Topics**: Logarithms, uniroot(), IVT, likelihood, exponential functions

### Weeks 5-6: Derivatives
**Classes**: 16-22
**Topics**: Linearization, power rule, product rule, quotient rule, chain rule

### Weeks 7-8: Optimization
**Classes**: 23-30
**Topics**: Partial derivatives, critical points, second derivative test, maximum likelihood, least squares

### Weeks 9-10: Integration Intro
**Classes**: 31-37
**Topics**: Riemann sums, definite integrals, probability rules, conditional probability

### Weeks 11-12: Continuous Distributions
**Classes**: 38-43
**Topics**: PDF, CDF, expected value, variance, percentiles, integration with Mathematica

### Week 13: Synthesis
**Classes**: 44-46
**Topics**: Connecting CDFs and PDFs, change of variables, review

## R Functions Reference

### By First Use

| R Function | First Used | Purpose |
|------------|------------|---------|
| `plot()` | [Class 3](class/class-3.html) | Basic plotting |
| `lines()` | [Class 3](class/class-3.html) | Add curves to plots |
| `uniroot()` | [Class 10](class/class-10.html) | Solve equations numerically |
| `exp()` | [Class 11](class/class-11.html) | Exponential function |
| `log()`, `log2()` | [Class 9](class/class-9.html) | Logarithm functions |
| `abline()` | [Class 11](class/class-11.html) | Add reference lines |
| `sum()` | [Class 26](class/class-26.html) | Sum vectors |
